creator: Alexander Terp
description: From report --waiting --until-exits (22ab94ce, 2026-10-21). The wait watch asks kill(pid, 0) once a second, which succeeds for a zombie nobody has reaped and for an unrelated process that took the pid. Neither has been seen: Codex's shells exit and reap their jobs. If it is, compare the process's start time at declaration with what is there now.
title: A wait on a process treats a zombie as alive, and pid reuse is not guarded
